g.text: Confirmed personalization at the start of a task sequence
24 synthetic episodes · four opposing profiles · three tasks · one repetition
Both arms may ask and save preferences. B also receives ALIGNS.md and the align skill.
Final exact preference fit: 12/12 in both arms.
Setup is a modeled confirmation reply per profile, not an observed interview. No human time was measured.
This information-gap comparison does not isolate file format or prove a general method advantage.
